title: 打家劫舍
statement: 一条街上有 n 间房屋排成一排，第 i 间存有现金 nums[i]。相邻的两间房屋不能在同一晚都被偷（否则触发警报）。在不触发警报的前提下，最多能偷到多少现金？

en.title: House Robber
en.statement: There are n houses in a row on a street; house i holds nums[i] in cash. Two adjacent houses cannot both be robbed on the same night (that triggers the alarm). What is the maximum amount of cash you can rob without triggering the alarm?

complexity.space: O(1) extra space (rolling variables; a dp array is O(n))
complexity.notes: n is the number of houses. dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i]). Recursion without memoization is exponential.

en.acmIoSpec: stdin: line 1 is n; line 2 has n integers nums. stdout: one integer, the maximum amount.

complexity.space: O(1) 额外空间（滚动变量；dp 数组为 O(n)）
complexity.officialRequirement: 官方未强制复杂度要求。
complexity.notes: n 为房屋数。dp[i] = max(dp[i-1], dp[i-2] + nums[i])。不带记忆化的递归是指数级。

cpp.acmIoSpec: stdin：第一行 n；第二行 n 个整数 nums。stdout：一个整数，最大金额。
